cards.en: to be strong; to be sturdy; healthy (adjective)

quiz.why: 다이어트 means dieting to lose weight; diet. 다이어트 중이라 저녁을 가볍게 먹어요. (I eat dinner lightly because I am on a diet.)
칫솔 means toothbrush. 부드러운 칫솔을 써요. (I use a soft toothbrush.)
주사 means injection. 독감 예방 주사를 꼭 맞으세요. (Please be sure to get your flu shot.)
알약 means pill; tablet. 의사가 흰색 알약을 주었어요. (The doctor gave me a white pill.)
소화제 means digestive medicine. 속이 답답할 때 소화제를 먹어요. (I take digestive medicine when my stomach feels heavy.)
치과 means dentistry; dental clinic. 치과에서 치료를 받았어요. (I received treatment at the dentist.)

fill.en: Please take your cold medicine after the meal.
Please be sure to get your flu shot.
I receive regular health checkups at the hospital.

quiz.why: 손가락 means finger. 다친 손가락에 반창고를 붙였어요. (I put a band-aid on my injured finger.)
가슴 means chest; heart. 숨을 깊이 쉬니 가슴이 시원해요. (Breathing deeply refreshes my chest.)
무릎 means knee; lap. 무릎 위에 담요를 덮고 쉬어요. (I cover my lap with a blanket and rest.)
손바닥 means palm. 손바닥 위에 작은 동전을 올려놓아요. (I put a small coin on my palm.)
왼손 means left hand. 왼손에 반지를 꼈어요. (I wore a ring on my left hand.)
피 means blood. 병원에서 피 검사를 받아요. (I get a blood test at the hospital.)

fill.en: I comb my long hair neatly with a comb.
I cover my lap with a blanket and rest.
There is a hole in my sock, so my toe shows.

cards.en: to be sick; to be unwell (honorific) (adjective)
to be new; to be fresh (adjective)
to open; to be held; to take place (verb)
to be old; to be long-standing (adjective)

quiz.why: 기침 means cough; coughing. 기침을 할 때는 입을 가리세요. (Please cover your mouth when you cough.)
두통 means headache. 스트레스를 받으면 두통이 생겨요. (When I get stressed, a headache occurs.)
배탈 means stomachache; upset stomach; stomach upset. 배탈 때문에 죽을 끓여 먹어요. (I boil and eat porridge because of an upset stomach.)
재채기 means sneeze; sneezing. 자꾸 재채기를 해요. (I keep sneezing.)
그대로 means as it is; intact. 선생님 말씀을 그대로 따라 해요. (I follow the teacher's words as they are.)
다양 means diversity; variety. 다양한 사람들과 이야기하며 배워요. (I learn while talking with diverse people.)

fill.en: I wrap a clean bandage around the wounded area.
I receive a lot of stress because of exams.

cards.en: to go wrong; to be mistaken (verb)
to be strong; to be powerful (adjective)

quiz.why: 올리다 means to raise; to increase. 손을 번쩍 올려요. (Raise your hand high.)
줄이다 means to reduce; to decrease. 쓰레기를 많이 줄여요. (Let's reduce trash a lot.)
가득 means full; completely. 행복이 가득한 하루를 보내세요. (Have a day full of happiness.)
기타 means etc.; others; and so on. 과일, 채소, 기타 등등을 샀어요. (I bought fruit, vegetables and so on.)
더욱 means more and more; further. 열심히 연습해서 실력이 더욱 좋아졌어요. (I practiced hard and my skills got even better.)
모든 means all; every. 준비가 모든 면에서 완벽해요. (The preparation is perfect in every aspect.)

fill.en: I bought fruit, vegetables and so on.
I measure the length of the desk with a ruler.
I practiced hard and my skills got even better.
to go wrong; to be mistaken

quiz.why: 부분 means part. 책의 이 부분을 소리 내어 읽어요. (I read this section of the book aloud.)
센티미터 means centimeter. 자로 십 센티미터 길이를 재어요. (I measure a length of ten centimeters with a ruler.)
아무리 means no matter how. 아무리 힘들어도 끝까지 포기하지 않아요. (No matter how hard it is, I do not give up.)
완전히 means completely; fully. 병이 완전히 나았어요. (I have fully recovered from illness.)
적당하다 means suitable; proper; moderate. 온도가 아주 적당해요. (The temperature is very moderate.)
정확 means accuracy; correctness. 정확한 시간을 알려 주세요. (Please let me know the exact time.)

fill.en: Please put a bit of salt in the soup.
I have fully recovered from illness.

quiz.why: 특별히 means specially; particularly; especially. 특별히 부탁할 일이 있어요. (I have a favor to ask especially.)
숫자 means number; figure. 일부터 십까지 숫자를 세어요. (I count numbers from one to ten.)
넘다 means to cross; to exceed. 산길을 넘어 이웃 마을로 가요. (I go over the mountain path to the neighboring village.)
대 means generation; unit counter. 집에 컴퓨터 두 대를 두고 써요. (I keep and use two computers at home.)
둘째 means second; 2nd. 제 둘째 동생은 초등학생이에요. (My second younger sibling is an elementary student.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "three or four"?
quiz.why: 서너 means three or four. 사과 서너 개만 사 오세요. (Please buy and bring three or four apples.)

fill.en: I bought apples and pears, two of each.
I will do the rest of the homework tomorrow.
On weekends, I mostly rest comfortably at home.

cards.en: one or two; a couple of (determiner)

quiz.why: 전부 means all; whole. 전부 얼마예요? (How much is it in total?)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "one or two"?
quiz.why: 한두 means one or two; a couple of. 한두 명만 남았어요. (Only one or two people remained.)
가까이 means near; close to. 친구가 제 가까이로 다가왔어요. (My friend came close to me.)
바깥쪽 means outside; outer side. 상자의 바깥쪽에 주소를 써요. (I write the address on the outer side of the box.)
쌓다 means pile; heap. 다양한 경험을 쌓으며 성장해요. (I grow while building various experiences.)
앞쪽 means front; front side. 버스 앞쪽 문으로 승객이 내려요. (Passengers alight through the front door of the bus.)

fill.en: My friend came close to me.
I came out to get fresh air outside because I felt stuffy.
I write the address on the outer side of the box.

cards.en: to be soft; to be tender (adjective)
to be blue; to be green (adjective)
to be thin; to be slender (adjective)

quiz.why: 중심 means center; core. 도시 중심가를 걸어요. (I walk through the city center.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be soft"?
quiz.why: 부드럽다 means to be soft; to be tender. 이 빵은 맛이 아주 부드러워요. (This bread tastes very soft.)
푸르다 means to be blue; to be green. 가을 하늘이 높고 푸릅니다. (The autumn sky is high and blue.)
색깔 means color. 색깔이 진한 과일이 맛도 달아요. (Fruits with deep colors are also sweet in taste.)
파랗다 means blue. 바닷물이 파랗게 반짝여요. (The sea water sparkles blue.)
갈색 means brown (color). 제 가방은 짙은 갈색이에요. (My bag is dark brown.)

fill.en: I cross looking at the green light of the pedestrian crossing.
Snow fell, so the world is entirely white.

fill.q: "(in -ㄹ 줄 알다) how to" in Korean: ___

cards.en: to be splendid; to be gorgeous; flashy (adjective)

quiz.why: 노란색 means yellow (color). 봄이 되면 노란색 개나리가 피어요. (When spring comes, yellow forsythia blooms.)
분홍색 means pink (color). 분홍색 벚꽃이 길가에 만발했어요. (Pink cherry blossoms bloomed in full along the street.)
색 means color; tint; hue. 밝은 색 옷을 입으니 기분이 좋아요. (Wearing bright-colored clothes puts me in a good mood.)
파란색 means blue color; blue. 파란색 셔츠를 샀어요. (I bought a blue shirt.)
화려하다 means to be splendid; to be gorgeous; flashy. 화려한 옷을 입었어요. (I wore flashy clothes.)
추석 means Chuseok; Korean Thanksgiving. 추석 명절에 온 가족이 모여요. (The whole family gathers on the Chuseok holiday.)

fill.en: Please stop when the traffic light is red.

cards.en: Taegeukgi; the national flag of South Korea (noun)

quiz.why: 크리스마스 means Christmas. 크리스마스 트리를 꾸며요. (I decorate the Christmas tree.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "New Year's bow"?
quiz.why: 세배 means New Year's bow. 세배를 하고 세뱃돈을 받았어요. (I bowed and received New Year's gift money.)
태극기 means Taegeukgi; the national flag of South Korea. 태극기가 높이 펄럭여요. (The Taegeukgi flaps high.)
양말 means socks. 서랍에 깨끗한 양말을 정리해요. (I organize clean socks in the drawer.)
매다 means tie; bind; lace. 양복에 멋진 넥타이를 맸어요. (I wore a stylish necktie with my suit.)
넥타이 means necktie; tie. 아버지께 실크 넥타이를 선물했어요. (I presented a silk necktie to my father.)

fill.en: I enjoy yunnori with my family.
I stayed overnight at a hanok.

quiz.why: 반바지 means shorts; short pants. 반바지에 흰 티셔츠를 입었어요. (I wore a white T-shirt with shorts.)
사이즈 means size; measurement. 옷이 조금 작아서 큰 사이즈로 바꿔요. (The clothes are small, so I change to a larger size.)
수영복 means swimsuit; bathing suit. 바다에 가려고 새 수영복을 샀어요. (I bought a new swimsuit to go to the sea.)
양복 means suit (western style). 백화점에서 남성 양복을 맞췄어요. (I had a men's suit tailored at the department store.)
원피스 means one-piece dress; dress. 원피스를 한 벌 샀어요. (I bought a one-piece dress.)
화장품 means cosmetics; makeup. 피부에 맞는 화장품을 써요. (I use cosmetics that suit my skin.)

fill.en: I bought a cotton underwear set at the department store.
I wipe sweat cleanly with a handkerchief.
I bought a new swimsuit to go to the sea.

cards.en: fall down; trip over; tumble over (verb)

quiz.why: 벌다 means make; earn. 열심히 일해서 돈을 많이 벌었어요. (I worked hard and earned a lot of money.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "free of charge"?
quiz.why: 공짜 means free of charge; freebie. 음료수를 공짜로 하나 더 받았어요. (I received one more beverage for free.)
무료 means free; free of charge. 가게에서 무료 음료수를 제공해요. (The shop offers free drinks.)
넘어지다 means fall down; trip over; tumble over. 아이가 넘어지지 않게 손을 잡아요. (I hold the child's hand so they don't fall.)
마치다 means complete; finish. 수업을 마치고 식당에 가요. (After finishing class, I go to the cafeteria.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to lie down"?
quiz.why: 눕다 means to lie down. 방바닥에 누워 잠시 쉬었어요. (I lay down on the room floor and rested briefly.)

fill.en: I am full, so I will stop eating.

quiz.why: 자꾸 means frequently; repeatedly; again and again. 전화벨이 자꾸 울려요. (The phone bell rings repeatedly.)
만지다 means touch. 박물관 작품을 만지지 마세요. (Please do not touch the museum artworks.)
꾸다 means to dream (a dream). 친구에게 돈을 조금 꿨어요. (I borrowed a bit of money from a friend.)
서두르다 means to hurry; to rush. 시간이 없으니 발걸음을 서두르세요. (There is no time, so please hurry your steps.)
풀다 means untie. 어려운 수학 문제를 혼자 풀었어요. (I solved the difficult math problem by myself.)
간단히 means simply; briefly. 자기소개를 간단히 해 주세요. (Please introduce yourself briefly.)

fill.en: I went out with a friend on the weekend.
I finally decided on the travel date.

cards.en: to take out; to pull out (verb)
to be dirty; to be foul (adjective)

quiz.why: 깨끗이 means cleanly; neatly. 방을 깨끗이 청소하고 환기해요. (I clean the room neatly and air it out.)
낮잠 means nap; daytime sleep. 낮잠을 조금 자고 나니 개운해요. (After taking a short nap, I feel refreshed.)
뜨다 means float; buoy. 동쪽 바다에서 붉은 해가 떠요. (The red sun rises from the eastern sea.)
목욕 means bath. 욕조에서 편안하게 목욕을 즐겨요. (I comfortably enjoy a bath in the bathtub.)
반드시 means must; certainly. 외출할 때 문을 반드시 잠그세요. (Make sure you certainly lock the door when going out.)
뽑다 means pull; pick; pluck. 우리 반 대표를 투표로 뽑았어요. (We elected our class representative by vote.)

fill.en: I try hard to achieve my goal.
Make sure you certainly lock the door when going out.
I depart early because transportation is inconvenient.
to take out; to pull out

cards.en: commit an error; blunder; do wrong (verb)
to spill; to shed; to drop (verb)

quiz.why: 잃다 means lose. 방향을 잃지 마세요. (Do not lose your way.)
잡다 means to catch; to hold. 날아가는 공을 잡았어요. (I caught the flying ball.)
직접 means directly; in person. 선생님을 직접 만나요. (I meet the teacher in person.)
틀다 means turn on (device); twist. 텔레비전을 틀었어요. (I turned on the television.)
행동 means behavior; action. 그의 행동을 눈여겨보았어요. (I watched his actions carefully.)
흘리다 means to spill; to shed; to drop. 감동해서 눈물을 흘려요. (I shed tears being touched.)

fill.en: I insert coins into the drink vending machine.
I sent a birthday gift to my friend by parcel.
I bought a bag to hold goods at the mart.
commit an error; blunder; do wrong

cards.en: something extra for free; on the house; service (noun)

quiz.why: 교환 means exchange; swap. 영수증을 가져오시면 교환이 돼요. (If you bring the receipt, exchange is possible.)
상품 means product; merchandise. 가게에서 신상품을 할인 판매해요. (The store sells new products at a discount.)
예약 means reservation; booking. 호텔 예약을 확인해요. (I check the hotel reservation.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be sold"?
quiz.why: 팔리다 means to be sold; sell. 물건이 아주 잘 팔려요. (The goods sell very well.)
곧 means immediately. 친구가 곧 도착해요. (My friend arrives soon.)
금방 means soon; right away. 친구가 금방 도착할 거예요. (My friend will arrive soon.)

fill.en: They provided fruits as a complimentary service for dessert.
I book a train ticket in advance.

quiz.why: 평소 means ordinary times; usual. 평소에 운동을 자주 해요. (I exercise often usually.)
가끔 means sometimes. 고향 친구들에게 가끔 연락해요. (I occasionally contact my hometown friends.)
이틀 means the second day. 약속 날짜가 이틀 앞으로 다가왔어요. (The appointment date has come two days ahead.)
과거 means past. 과거에 한국에 산 적이 있어요. (I have lived in Korea in the past.)
다음날 means next day; following day. 다음날 아침 일찍 공항으로 떠나요. (I leave for the airport early the next morning.)
마지막 means last; final. 시험의 마지막 문제를 풀었어요. (I solved the last question of the exam.)

fill.en: It's really been a long time! Have you been well?
The appointment date has come two days ahead.
I save part of my salary every month.

cards.en: at this time; at this moment (noun)

quiz.why: 새벽 means dawn; early morning. 아침 일찍 새벽 다섯 시에 일어났어요. (I woke up early in the morning at five at dawn.)
연휴 means consecutive holidays; long weekend. 연휴에 여행을 가요. (I go on a trip during the long holiday.)
오랫동안 means for a long time. 오랫동안 알고 지냈어요. (We have known each other for a long time.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "at this time"?
quiz.why: 이때 means at this time; at this moment. 이때를 놓치지 마세요. (Do not miss this moment.)
이후 means after that; since; hereafter. 오후 두 시 이후에 와요. (Come after 2 p.m.)
첫날 means first day. 개학 첫날이라 설레요. (I am excited because it is the first day of school.)

fill.en: We have known each other for a long time.

cards.en: to be urgent; to be hurried (adjective)
to be familiar; to be accustomed (adjective)

quiz.why: 영하 means below zero; sub-zero. 오늘 아침 기온은 영하 오 도예요. (This morning's temperature is minus five degrees.)
기온 means temperature; air temperature. 겨울에는 기온이 영하로 내려가요. (In winter, the temperature drops below zero.)
안개 means fog; mist. 안개 때문에 앞이 잘 안 보여요. (I cannot see ahead well because of fog.)
장마 means monsoon; rainy season. 장마철에는 비가 자주 와요. (It rains often during rainy season.)
믿다 means believe; trust. 약속을 꼭 지킬 거라고 믿어요. (I believe you will surely keep the promise.)
원하다 means to want; to wish. 제가 진정으로 원하는 직업이에요. (It is the job that I truly want.)

fill.en: I cannot see ahead well because of fog.
It rains often during rainy season.

cards.en: to be scary; to be afraid (adjective)
be surprised; be astonished; be shocked; be scared (verb)
get angry; be furious; be enraged (verb)

quiz.why: 참다 means endure; withstand; bear; be patient. 조금만 더 참으세요. (Please endure just a little more.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be scary"?
quiz.why: 무섭다 means to be scary; to be afraid. 무서운 영화를 보고 깜짝 놀랐어요. (I watched a scary movie and was surprised.)
싸우다 means to fight; to quarrel. 어제 동생과 다투며 싸웠어요. (Yesterday I quarrelled and fought with my sibling.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be envious"?
quiz.why: 부럽다 means to be envious; to envy. 노래를 잘하는 동생이 참 부러워요. (I'm really envious of my sibling who sings well.)
화나다 means get angry; be furious; be enraged. 화난 얼굴을 풀고 웃어 보세요. (Please soften your angry face and smile.)
걱정 means worry; concern. 너무 걱정하지 말고 힘내세요. (Don't worry too much and cheer up.)

fill.en: Even in difficult situations, I keep hope.
Don't worry too much and cheer up.
I opened up my worries to my friend.

cards.en: to be shy; to be ashamed (adjective)
to be precious; to be valuable (adjective)

quiz.why: 귀찮다 means troublesome; annoying; tiresome. 청소하기 귀찮아도 방을 치워요. (Even though cleaning is bothersome, I tidy up the room.)
깜짝 means with surprise; surprisingly. 친구들이 깜짝 파티를 준비해 줬어요. (Friends prepared a surprise party for me.)
답답하다 means to stifling; suffocating. 일이 잘 안 풀려서 마음이 답답해요. (Things are not working out, so my heart feels frustrated.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to be shy"?
quiz.why: 부끄럽다 means to be shy; to be ashamed. 칭찬을 받아서 얼굴이 부끄럽게 붉어졌어요. (My face turned bashfully red receiving compliments.)
섭섭하다 means to sorry; regrettable. 약속을 취소해서 섭섭한 마음이 들었어요. (I felt disappointed because the appointment was cancelled.)
슬픔 means sadness; grief. 친구와 기쁨과 슬픔을 함께 나눠요. (I share joy and sadness together with friends.)

fill.en: I share joy and sadness together with friends.
I hear the child's crying sound.

cards.en: to be bent; to be curved (verb)

quiz.why: 잊어버리다 means forget; be forgetful of. 비밀번호를 잊어버리지 마세요. (Do not forget your password.)
지루하다 means boring; tedious. 기다리는 시간이 지루했어요. (The waiting time was tedious.)
편안 means comfort; peace; ease. 마음이 아주 편안해요. (My heart is very comfortable.)
깎다 means peel. 시장 가게에서 가격을 조금 깎았어요. (I haggled the price down a bit at the market.)
끓이다 means to boil; to brew. 주전자에 물을 끓여서 차를 마셔요. (I boil water in the kettle and drink tea.)
볶다 means to stir-fry; roast. 참기름을 넣고 밥을 맛있게 볶았어요. (I added sesame oil and fried rice deliciously.)

fill.en: Please hold hot pots wearing oven mitts.

quiz.why: 접시 means plate; dish. 접시를 깨끗이 닦아요. (I wipe the plate cleanly.)
튀기다 means fry; deep-fry. 바삭하게 튀겨 냅니다. (I fry it out crisply.)
과자 means snack. 마트에서 바삭한 과자를 샀어요. (I bought crispy cookies at the mart.)
생선 means fish (as food). 시장에서 싱싱한 생선을 샀어요. (I bought fresh fish at the market.)
감자 means potato. 시장 야채 가게에서 햇감자를 샀어요. (I bought fresh potatoes at the market vegetable shop.)
달걀 means egg. 마트에서 신선한 달걀 한 판을 샀어요. (I bought a tray of fresh eggs at the mart.)

fill.en: I put fresh pork into the stew.
I bought fresh fish at the market.
The stew boils bubbling in the earthenware pot.

quiz.why: 만두 means mandu; dumpling. 분식집에서 고기만두를 주문했어요. (I ordered meat dumplings at the snack bar.)
분식 means snack food; flour-based food. 분식은 싸고 간편해서 인기가 많아요. (Snack food is popular because it is cheap and convenient.)
상추 means lettuce. 텃밭에서 싱싱한 상추를 땄어요. (I picked fresh lettuce in the vegetable garden.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "spoon and chopsticks"?
quiz.why: 수저 means spoon and chopsticks. 수저통에서 숟가락을 꺼냈어요. (I took a spoon out of the cutlery holder.)
식빵 means loaf bread; white bread. 식빵에 달콤한 딸기잼을 발라요. (I spread sweet strawberry jam on loaf bread.)
야채 means vegetables; greens. 시장에서 신선한 야채를 샀어요. (I bought fresh vegetables at the market.)

fill.en: I share strawberry-flavored candies with children.
I pair pork belly with lettuce and ssamjang.
I picked fresh lettuce in the vegetable garden.

cards.en: a cup of; a drink; a glass of (noun)

quiz.why: 짬뽕 means jjamppong; spicy seafood noodle soup. 중국집에서 짬뽕을 시켰어요. (I ordered jjamppong at the Chinese restaurant.)
칼국수 means kal-guksu; knife-cut noodle soup. 바지락 칼국수가 시원해요. (Clam noodle soup is refreshing.)
피자 means pizza. 친구들과 피자를 나눠 먹어요. (I share pizza with friends.)
음료 means beverage; drink. 카페에서 과일 음료를 골랐어요. (I chose a fruit drink at the cafe.)
맥주 means beer. 친구와 치킨에 맥주를 곁들여 먹어요. (I eat chicken accompanied by beer with a friend.)
얼음 means ice. 얼음이 녹아 물이 되었어요. (The ice melted and became water.)

fill.en: I ordered jajangmyeon and sweet and sour pork.
I dip the fried food into tteokbokki sauce.

quiz.why: 배추 means napa cabbage; Chinese cabbage. 시장에서 신선한 배추 세 포기를 샀어요. (I bought three heads of fresh cabbage at the market.)
김 means steam. 뜨거운 국에서 하얀 김이 나요. (White steam rises from the hot soup.)
고추장 means red pepper paste; gochujang. 고추장으로 떡볶이 양념을 만들어요. (I make tteokbokki sauce with gochujang.)
된장 means soybean paste. 뚝배기에 된장 한 스푼을 풀어요. (I dissolve a spoonful of soybean paste in the earthen pot.)
소고기 means beef. 미역국에 신선한 소고기를 넣어요. (I put fresh beef into the seaweed soup.)
오이 means cucumber. 오이를 얇게 썰어요. (I slice the cucumber thinly.)

fill.en: I put gas in the car at the gas station.
Spicy seasoned chicken meat is very delicious.
I dissolve a spoonful of soybean paste in the earthen pot.

cards.en: to be like this; be so (adjective)

quiz.why: 빵집 means bakery. 빵집 앞을 지날 때 고소한 냄새가 나요. (A savory smell comes when passing by the bakery.)
일식집 means Japanese restaurant. 그 일식집 초밥이 맛있어요. (The sushi at that Japanese restaurant is delicious.)
한식집 means Korean restaurant. 그 한식집은 반찬이 잘 나와요. (Side dishes are served well at that Korean restaurant.)
진하다 means thick; rich; dark; deep. 향기가 아주 진해요. (The scent is very deep.)
또는 means or; either. 토요일 또는 일요일에 만나요. (Let's meet on Saturday or Sunday.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "and the like"?
quiz.why: 등 means and the like; etc.. 연필, 지우개 등을 필통에 챙겨요. (I pack pencils, erasers, etc. into the pencil case.)

fill.en: Here is the coffee you ordered.
I went to my regular Chinese restaurant.
Side dishes are served well at that Korean restaurant.

cards.en: this gentleman; this lady; this person (honorific) (pronoun)

quiz.why: 켤레 means pair. 양말 두 켤레를 선물로 받았어요. (I received two pairs of socks as a present.)
회 means time; round; episode. 하루에 세 회 복용하세요. (Take it three times a day.)
그곳 means that place; there. 다음에 친구와 그곳에 다시 가요. (Next time I will go to that place again with a friend.)
이곳 means here; this place. 이곳에서 사진을 찍어요. (Let's take a picture here.)
저거 means that thing; that. 저거 제 가방이에요. (That thing is my bag.)
저분 means that gentleman; that lady (honorific). 저분이 누구인지 아세요? (Do you know who that person is?)
수건 means towel. 욕실에 깨끗한 수건을 놓았어요. (I put clean towels in the bathroom.)
빨래 means washing; laundry. 날씨가 맑아서 이불 빨래를 널었어요. (The weather was sunny, so I hung out the blanket laundry.)
휴지 means tissue; toilet paper. 휴지 좀 건네주세요. (Please pass me some tissue.)
식탁 means dining table. 가족이 식탁에 둘러앉았어요. (The family sat around the dining table.)
냉장고 means refrigerator; fridge. 냉장고 문을 꼭 닫아 주세요. (Please close the refrigerator door tightly.)
소파 means sofa; couch. 가구점에서 갈색 소파를 골랐어요. (I chose a brown sofa at the furniture store.)

fill.en: I left my coat at the dry cleaner's.
I finished tidying up the room.

cards.en: to build; to make; to cook (verb)
boarding fee; room and board cost (noun)

quiz.why: 초 means candle; second; beginning. 1분은 60초예요. (One minute is 60 seconds.)
좁다 means small. 골목길이 좁아서 차가 못 가요. (The alley is narrow, so cars cannot pass.)
이삿짐 means moving luggage; moving goods. 상자에 이삿짐을 싸요. (I pack the moving things into boxes.)
마당 means yard; garden. 집 앞 마당에 꽃을 심었어요. (I planted flowers in the yard in front of the house.)
침실 means bedroom. 침실을 깨끗하게 청소해요. (I clean the bedroom cleanly.)
기타 means guitar. 노래를 부르며 기타를 쳤어요. (I played the guitar while singing a song.)

fill.en: Meals are included in the boarding fee.
I planted flowers in the yard in front of the house.
I visit my hometown home for the holiday.

quiz.why: 인형 means doll; puppet; stuffed animal. 방에 인형이 많이 있어요. (There are many dolls in the room.)
미술관 means art museum; art gallery. 미술관 안에서는 사진을 못 찍어요. (You cannot take photos inside the art museum.)
만화 means comics; manga; cartoon. 어릴 때 텔레비전 만화를 자주 봤어요. (I often watched TV cartoons when I was little.)
비디오 means video. 한국어 학습 비디오를 보며 따라 해요. (I watch and follow Korean learning videos.)
연예인 means celebrity; entertainer. 좋아하는 연예인이에요. (He is my favorite entertainer.)
인기 means popularity. 그 노래가 인기를 끌어요. (That song is gaining popularity.)

fill.en: Ads for the new product launch were posted on the street.
I often watched TV cartoons when I was little.
A line is standing long in front of the ticket office.

quiz.why: 달리기 means running. 달리기 시합에서 일등을 했어요. (I won first place in the running race.)
뛰다 means jump; hop; leap. 기쁜 소식에 가슴이 두근두근 뛰었어요. (My heart beat thumping at the joyful news.)
스키장 means ski resort. 스키장에서 하루 종일 스키를 탔어요. (I skied all day long at the ski resort.)
이기다 means to win; beat. 우리 팀이 이겼어요. (Our team won.)
테니스장 means tennis court. 새로 지은 테니스장이에요. (It is a newly built tennis court.)
소 means filling. 만두 안에 맛있는 고기 소를 넣어요. (I put delicious meat filling inside the dumpling.)

fill.en: I skied all day long at the ski resort.
I watched sports broadcast on TV.

quiz.why: 동물원 means zoo. 동물원에서 기린과 판다를 보았어요. (I saw giraffes and pandas at the zoo.)
물고기 means fish. 바닷가에서 작은 물고기를 잡았어요. (I caught small fish at the beach.)
토끼 means rabbit; bunny; hare. 토끼가 풀을 뜯어 먹어요. (The rabbit nibbles on grass.)
하늘 means sky. 푸른 하늘에 흰 구름이 떠 있어요. (White clouds float in the blue sky.)
경치 means scenery; view. 창밖으로 멋진 바다 경치가 보여요. (A wonderful ocean view is seen outside the window.)
땅 means land; ground. 땅 위에 예쁜 꽃씨를 심었어요. (I planted pretty flower seeds in the ground.)

fill.en: The elephant's trunk is very long.

quiz.why: 풍경 means scenery; scene; view; landscape. 창밖 풍경을 바라보아요. (I look at the scenery outside the window.)
피다 means bloom; blossom. 공원에 벚꽃이 활짝 피었어요. (Cherry blossoms bloomed fully in the park.)
자라다 means to grow. 저는 조용한 시골 마을에서 자랐어요. (I grew up in a quiet rural village.)
장미 means rose. 장미 한 송이를 선물해요. (I give a single rose as a gift.)
그분 means that person (honorific). 저기 계신 그분께 한번 물어보세요. (Please ask that person over there.)
아줌마 means middle-aged woman; ajumma. 이웃집 아줌마와 반갑게 인사해요. (I greet the neighborhood lady warmly.)

fill.en: I take care of the garden beautifully.
Two young ladies enter the clothing store.

quiz.why: 남녀 means men and women; both sexes. 남녀 학생들이 함께 모여 토론해요. (Male and female students gather together to discuss.)
부자 means rich person. 부자가 되어 이웃을 돕고 싶어요. (I want to become wealthy and help neighbors.)
스스로 means by oneself; voluntarily. 스스로 결정하고 책임을 져요. (I decide on my own and take responsibility.)
자신 means oneself; confidence. 시험에 자신이 있어요. (I have confidence in the exam.)
관계 means official world; government circles. 두 사람의 관계가 아주 가까워요. (The relationship between the two is very close.)
결혼 means marriage; wedding; union; matrimony. 결혼해서 행복하게 살고 있어요. (I got married and am living happily.)

fill.en: I decide on my own and take responsibility.
I have confidence in the exam.

cards.en: embrace; hug; hold someone in one's arms (verb)

quiz.why: 데려오다 means to bring (someone). 학교에서 동생을 데려올게요. (I will bring my sibling from school.)
선배 means senior. 동아리 선배들과 함께 점심을 먹어요. (I have lunch with seniors from the club.)
식구 means family member; family. 온 식구가 둘러앉아 저녁을 먹어요. (The whole family sits around to eat dinner.)
신혼여행 means honeymoon. 신혼여행에서 찍은 사진이 예뻐요. (Photos taken on the honeymoon are pretty.)
아빠 means dad; daddy. 아빠가 맛있는 간식을 사 오셨어요. (Dad bought and brought delicious snacks.)
애인 means lover; partner. 애인에게 줄 선물을 골랐어요. (I picked a gift to give to my partner.)

fill.en: The whole family sits around to eat dinner.
The groom and bride enter the wedding hall.

quiz.why: 이모 means maternal aunt. 이모가 맛있는 음식을 줘요. (My aunt gives me delicious food.)
형제 means brothers; siblings. 형제끼리 서로 도와요. (Brothers help each other.)
경찰 means police; policing. 길을 잃어서 경찰의 도움을 받았어요. (I got lost and received help from the police.)
교수 means professor. 교수님의 연구실을 찾아갔어요. (I visited the professor's office.)
변호사 means lawyer; attorney. 친절한 변호사의 도움을 받았어요. (I received help from a kind attorney.)
선수 means athlete; player. 국가대표 선수가 되려고 매일 훈련해요. (He trains daily to become a national athlete.)

fill.en: My childhood dream was to be a wonderful artist.
My younger sister is a university hospital nurse.
I got lost and received help from the police.

quiz.why: 늙다 means to grow old; age. 나이가 들어도 마음은 늙지 않아요. (Even as age increases, the heart does not age.)
청년 means young person; youth. 청년들이 모여 토론해요. (Young people gather to debate.)
날씬하다 means slim; slender. 날씬한 핏의 원피스를 입었어요. (I wore a slim-fit dress.)
멋 means stylishness; being fashionable; being chic. 한복은 전통의 멋이 담겨 있어요. (Hanbok embodies the stylish charm of tradition.)
정문 means main gate; front gate. 정문으로 버스가 들어와요. (A bus enters through the main gate.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "high school student"?
quiz.why: 고등학생 means high school student. 고등학생들이 버스에 많이 타요. (Many high school students board the bus.)

fill.en: A bus enters through the main gate.

fill.q: 이번 학기에 ___을 한 번도 안 했어요.
fill.en: I wasn't absent even once this semester.
There is a high school near my house.

quiz.why: 입학 means admission to school; entrance. 입학 축하 선물을 줘요. (I give an admission congratulatory gift.)
지각 means being late; tardiness. 지각하지 않게 서둘러요. (Hurry up so as not to be late.)
출석 means attendance; presence. 모든 수업에 출석했어요. (I attended all classes.)
외우다 means memorize. 시험을 위해 문법을 외웠어요. (I memorized grammar for the exam.)
지우다 means erase. 지우개로 잘못 쓴 글자를 지웠어요. (I erased the misspelled letter with an eraser.)
일기 means diary; journal. 한국어로 짧은 일기를 써요. (I write a short diary entry in Korean.)

fill.en: I attend an elementary school near my house.
Elementary students play on the playground.

quiz.why: 교과서 means textbook. 교과서를 읽으며 열심히 예습해요. (I prepare thoroughly while reading the textbook.)
기억 means memory; remembrance. 그 사람의 전화번호가 기억에 없어요. (That person's phone number is not in my memory.)
문제 means problem; issue. 문제가 생기면 바로 상의하세요. (If a problem arises, consult right away.)
상 means good; top. 저녁 식사를 위해 식탁 상을 차려요. (I set the dining table for dinner.)
예습 means preview; preparation for class. 예습을 열심히 했어요. (I prepared hard for the lesson.)
종이 means paper. 종이 한 장만 주세요. (Please give me a sheet of paper.)

fill.en: I bought a thick spiral notebook at the bookstore.
If a problem arises, consult right away.
I review for an hour every evening.

cards.en: immigration; entry and departure from a country (noun)

quiz.why: 국제 means international. 국제 전화 요금이 많이 나왔어요. (The international phone call bill came out high.)
세상 means world; society. 모두가 행복한 세상을 꿈꿔요. (I dream of a world where everyone is happy.)
안전 means safety; security. 자동차를 탈 때는 안전벨트를 매세요. (Please fasten your seatbelt when riding a car.)
금지 means ban. 건물 안에서는 흡연이 금지예요. (Smoking is prohibited inside the building.)
자기소개 means self-introduction. 한국어로 자기소개를 준비했어요. (I prepared a self-introduction in Korean.)
뵙다 means to see; meet (hon.). 내일 연구실에서 교수님을 뵙겠습니다. (I will meet the professor in the office tomorrow.)

fill.en: All citizens must obey the law well.
I always carry my ID card in my wallet.
Please fasten your seatbelt when riding a car.
immigration; entry and departure from a country

quiz.why: 환영 means welcome. 환영 파티를 열었어요. (We threw a welcome party.)
사실 means fact. 사실 저는 매운 것을 잘 못 먹어요. (Actually, I cannot eat spicy food well.)
아무것 means anything. 점심은 아무것이나 다 좋아요. (Anything is fine for lunch.)
진짜 means authentic. 그 이야기가 진짜예요? (Is that story real?)
알아보다 means investigate; examine; look into. 오랜만에 만난 친구를 알아봤어요. (I recognized my friend who I met after a long time.)
의미 means meaning; sense. 의미가 좋은 노래를 들었어요. (I listened to a song with a nice meaning.)

fill.en: Do not compare yourself with others.

quiz.why: 만약 means supposing. 만약 도움이 필요하면 꼭 연락하세요. (In case you need help, definitely contact me.)
분명하다 means clear; distinct. 이유가 분명하니 안심하세요. (The reason is clear, so rest assured.)
소식 means news; word. 가족에게 자주 소식을 전해 주세요. (Please send news to your family often.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to go poorly"?
quiz.why: 안되다 means to go poorly; pitiful. 친구가 아프다니 참 안됐어요. (It is very unfortunate that my friend is sick.)
옳다 means right; correct; proper. 옳은 판단을 했어요. (You made the right judgment.)
전하다 means convey; give; pass on. 선생님께 편지를 전했어요. (I handed the letter to the teacher.)

fill.en: Please send news to your family often.
Oh no, has the appointment time already arrived?

fill.q: 그 친구는 ___ 지금 집에 있을 거예요.
fill.en: That friend is probably at home now.

quiz.why: 메시지 means message. 메시지를 확인하고 바로 답장해요. (I check the message and reply immediately.)
통화 means phone conversation; call. 지금 통화 괜찮으세요? (Are you okay to talk on the phone now?)
거절 means refusal; rejection; denial. 친구의 제안을 거절하기 미안해요. (I feel sorry to decline my friend's suggestion.)
여쭙다 means ask; inquire (honorific). 한 가지 여쭙고 싶어요. (I would like to ask one thing.)
연결 means connection. 컴퓨터와 모니터를 케이블로 연결해요. (I connect the computer and monitor with a cable.)
전화기 means telephone; phone device. 새 전화기를 샀어요. (I bought a new telephone.)

fill.en: To Teacher, Sincerely yours, Min-soo Kim.
I feel sorry to decline my friend's suggestion.
The delivery courier delivered the parcel.

cards.en: be blocked; be closed; be clogged (verb)

quiz.why: 막히다 means be blocked; be closed; be clogged. 세면대 구멍이 머리카락으로 막혔어요. (The sink hole was clogged with hair.)
광주 means Gwangju. 광주에는 맛있는 음식이 참 많아요. (There is really a lot of delicious food in Gwangju.)
도시 means city. 복잡한 도시를 떠나 여행을 가요. (I leave the crowded city and go traveling.)
빌딩 means building. 회사 빌딩 로비에서 친구를 만나요. (I meet my friend in the lobby of the office building.)
울산 means Ulsan. 기차를 타고 울산에 가요. (I go to Ulsan by train.)
출구 means exit. 지하철 출구를 찾았어요. (I found the subway exit.)

fill.en: Daejeon is a city with very convenient transportation.
I leave the crowded city and go traveling.
Our neighborhood has clean air and is nice to live in.
be blocked; be closed; be clogged

cards.en: to walk here; come on foot (verb)
to go down; to head down (verb)

quiz.why: 지도 means map. 선생님의 따뜻한 지도를 받았어요. (I received warm guidance from the teacher.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "to walk here"?
quiz.why: 걸어오다 means to walk here; come on foot. 학교까지 천천히 걸어와요. (I walk slowly all the way to school.)
내려가다 means to go down; to head down. 엘리베이터를 타고 지하로 내려가요. (I take the elevator and go down to the basement.)
돌다 means to turn; to spin. 공원 주변을 한 바퀴 돌았어요. (I turned one round around the park.)
뒤쪽 means back; rear. 버스 뒤쪽 자리로 이동해 주세요. (Please move to the seats at the back of the bus.)
똑바로 means straight; upright. 의자에 허리를 펴고 똑바로 앉아요. (Sit upright on the chair with your back straight.)

fill.en: Please move to the seats at the back of the bus.
Sit upright on the chair with your back straight.
Mountains are seen far away outside the window.

quiz.why: 북쪽 means north. 북쪽 지방은 겨울에 눈이 많이 와요. (The northern region gets a lot of snow in winter.)
삼거리 means three-way intersection. 삼거리에서 오른쪽 길로 가세요. (Please take the right road at the three-way intersection.)
신호 means signal; sign. 빨간 신호에 차를 멈추었어요. (I stopped the car on the red signal.)
육교 means pedestrian overpass; footbridge. 육교 계단을 올라가요. (Climb the steps of the overpass.)
관광 means tourism. 서울 시내 관광을 하루 동안 했어요. (I did sightseeing in downtown Seoul for a day.)
소풍 means trip; picnic; outing. 소풍 갈 때 김밥을 맛있게 싸요. (I pack kimbap deliciously when going on a picnic.)

fill.en: I stopped the car on the red signal.
Cars depart as the traffic light changes.
Climb the steps of the overpass.

quiz.why: 이용 means use; utilization. 도서관 시설을 무료로 이용해요. (I use the library facilities for free.)
운전하다 means drive; operate. 주말에 차를 운전해서 바다에 가요. (I drive a car to the sea on weekends.)
기차역 means train station. 기차역 대합실에서 열차를 기다려요. (I wait for the train in the station waiting room.)
정거장 means station; stop. 다음 정거장에서 내려요. (I get off at the next stop.)
요리사 means cook; chef. 요리사가 되고 싶어요. (I want to become a chef.)
그만두다 means to quit; to stop doing. 건강을 위해 일을 그만두었어요. (I stopped working for my health.)

fill.en: A big car accident occurred on the road.
I wait for the train in the station waiting room.
I meet a friend at the subway station.

cards.en: going to work; arriving at work (noun)

quiz.why: 사업 means business; project. 새 사업을 시작하려고 계획을 세워요. (I make a plan to start a new business.)
직장 means workplace; job. 직장에서 열심히 일해요. (I work hard at my job.)
출퇴근 means commuting (to and from work). 출퇴근 시간에 길이 막혀요. (Traffic is heavy during commute hours.)
위험 means danger; risk. 위험을 미리 피해요. (Avoid danger in advance.)
성공 means success. 새 프로젝트를 성공으로 이끌었어요. (I led the new project to success.)

quiz.q: Which Korean word means "going to work"?
quiz.why: 출근 means going to work; arriving at work. 출근 시간이 빨라졌어요. (My work arrival time became earlier.)

fill.en: My work arrival time became earlier.
I returned from the business trip.
Traffic is heavy during commute hours.
